account-id.description: Account in which the role is defined, including a cross-account role's account.

alternate-id.description: Alternate role identifier, such as an LDAP distinguished name.

privilege.description: One privilege granted by this role per attribute.

role-id.description: Role identifier, such as a role ARN or security identifier, scoped to its authority.

description: An IAM role and its assigned privileges, distinct from the principal assuming it or a particular authenticated session. Based on OCSF 1.9.0: https://schema.ocsf.io/1.9.0/objects/iam_role.
name: iam-role
